rec.name: Conversion-Optimized PDP Template (Gallery Labels, Savings Badge, Variant Picker, Info Box, Rating Sliders, Cross-Sell, Comparison Table)
rec.status: Built — live on Ardap; cross-sell variant selection still open with client

what.text: A complete product page template built 1:1 from a Figma mockup, mostly from existing Sectionfy.io sections plus a few custom-coded ones. The gallery has a label ("Mit Langzeitwirkung"), a video thumbnail and an info bar below the image ("Wirkt sofort und dauerhaft bis zu 6 Wochen"). The buy box contains: a social-proof strip ("Kian, Max & 20.000+ andere lieben ARDAP"), title, short description with check-mark bullets, star rating, compare-at price with unit price in brackets and a single-line green "Du sparst - 20%" badge, a size variant picker with a "Bestseller" tag, a stock line, and a blue collapsible "Abgabegespräch erforderlich" box with an embedded video. Below that come a compact quantity selector, an orange Add-to-Cart button, an outlined "Zum Storefinder" button, a payment icon row, slider-style rating bars (Wirkungsdauer / Effektivität / Einfache Anwendung), a "Ergänzende Produkte" cross-sell row and a "PRO vs Repell" comparison table. Above the page sit a slideshow announcement bar and an optional breadcrumb.

why.text: The page stacks several conversion levers in the order a buyer's questions arise. Social proof and the benefit label build trust at first glance. A visible strike-through price, a savings badge and a "Bestseller" tag anchor value and steer the size choice. A stock line and an info box with video reduce uncertainty for a product that requires a handover consultation. A prominent single ATC plus a secondary store-finder button capture both online and offline buyers. Payment logos reduce checkout anxiety. Rating sliders and the comparison table answer "which product is right for me?" without leaving the page. The cross-sell row lifts AOV, and legally required unit prices in brackets keep the page compliant.

how.text: 1) Duplicate the live theme and build on a copy. 2) Assemble the product template from existing Sectionfy.io / CRO sections, as the theme editor shows: Media Label, Media info, Description, Bulletpoints, Social Proof, Product Review Badge, Variant picker, Inventory, Collapsible box, Custom Liquid, Buy buttons, a Button ("Zum Storefinder"), Store benefits. 3) Custom-code the sections that do not exist yet: the rating sliders, the PRO vs Repell comparison table and the cross-sell block. 4) Render the price as: compare-at (struck through), current price, unit price in a single pair of brackets, and a one-line savings badge. Recalculate the savings % per selected variant. 5) For cross-sell, pick the products through a product metafield on each product, and show the compare-at price and unit price in brackets. 6) Handle sold-out states: red/neutral label instead of green, no green check on the inventory line, and the sold-out button colour matching the label. 7) Each product has its own template, so port the main-product section JSON from the reference template to the others.

Breadcrumb show/hide (hidden, then re-enabled on request)
Media label text on the gallery (e.g. "Mit Langzeitwirkung")
Info bar below the gallery with an info icon
Social proof strip text
Variant picker: option label, "Bestseller" tag on a chosen variant, active state in orange
Savings badge: single-line text "Du sparst - X%"
Unit price in brackets after the price
Collapsible info box: headline, body text, video
Quantity selector size and ATC button (single line)
Secondary "Zum Storefinder" button label and link
Payment icon row
Slider-style rating bars: three labelled scales with end labels
Cross-sell products picked via product metafield
Comparison table columns and rows
Sold-out styling: label colour, ATC button colour, inventory text (formal "Sie")

dependencies.text: Sectionfy.io sections installed in the theme, plus custom Liquid for the sections that are not yet in the library. A product metafield per product to choose cross-sell products. Compare-at price and unit-price data on variants. Per-product templates, so the main-product section JSON has to be synced. German legal requirements (Grundpreis in brackets) apply. Requires store admin access and a copy of the live theme. The announcement bar slideshow is stored as a separate ticket.
